criterion: 九項無遺漏；適用項有方法及理由，不適用項有原因；單執行緒、RTOS 及硬即時案例依條件展開，未知資訊不被當作不適用或已驗證。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Nine applicability categories and seven groups have explicit applicable/not-applicable/unknown decisions and reasons. OS fixtures cover valid design, bare-metal non-applicability, unknown rejection and real-time phase obligations.
